title: Bones, Joints and Muscles
summary: The skeleton's jobs, types of joints, and how muscles work in pairs to move bones.

ib.note: Levers and forces in the body link to Physics Unit 2

objectives: I can describe the functions of the skeleton.
I can identify ball-and-socket, hinge, pivot, gliding and fixed joints.
I can explain how antagonistic muscle pairs move bones.
misconceptions: All joints move in the same way.
